objective: Show that the H2 control plane reaches real LLM, RAG, and MCP process boundaries while retaining accounting, trajectory, termination, and degradation evidence.
hypothesis: Each configured boundary will complete three independent minimal probes, and an injected boundary failure will terminate or degrade explicitly without losing the other local capabilities.

sample_size.rationale: This is a binary interoperability release test, not an effectiveness estimate. Three separate calls/processes detect a single cached or accidentally reused success while matching the pre-approved H23 acceptance contract.

noise.measured: success/failure classification is deterministic; provider latency and billed cost are recorded but not used to infer quality
noise.decision_rule: pass only if all 9 successes and all 3 explicit degradations occur with complete observability

rollback: Do not promote the real-interoperability proof; retain raw artifacts and continue independent offline work. No provider state is mutated by these probes.
stop_conditions: a probe would require a provider or framework outside the approved plan
